# OpAssignShortSyntax

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Code style](/rules/#code-style) · PhpStorm name: `OpAssignShortSyntaxInspection`

`$total = $total + $step` repeats the target; the compound assignment
`$total += $step` says the same thing more directly.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{3,4,5,6,7,8,9,10,11} [Before]
<?php
function tally(int $count, string $label, array $grid, $buf) {
    $count = $count + 5;
    $count = $count - $step;
    $count = ($count % 7);
    $count = $count << 1;
    $label = $label . '-' . $count . '!';
    $count = $count * 3 * $k;
    $count = $count + ($k * 2);
    $grid[1] = $grid[1] | 4;
    $buf[0] = $buf[0] . 'z';

    $count = 5 + $count;          // reversed operands
    $count = $count - $a - $b;    // '-' cannot be regrouped
    $count = $count + $k * 2;     // fragment is a binary expression
    $count = $count ** 2;         // '**' not eligible
    $label[0] = $label[0] . 'x';  // string offset (typed string)
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
function tally(int $count, string $label, array $grid, $buf) {
    $count += 5;
    $count -= $step;
    $count %= 7;
    $count <<= 1;
    $label .= '-' . $count . '!';
    $count *= 3 * $k;
    $count += ($k * 2);
    $grid[1] |= 4;
    $buf[0] .= 'z';

    $count = 5 + $count;          // reversed operands
    $count = $count - $a - $b;    // '-' cannot be regrouped
    $count = $count + $k * 2;     // fragment is a binary expression
    $count = $count ** 2;         // '**' not eligible
    $label[0] = $label[0] . 'x';  // string offset (typed string)
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 3: Use the compound form &#39;$count += 5&#39;.</li>
<li>line 4: Use the compound form &#39;$count -= $step&#39;.</li>
<li>line 5: Use the compound form &#39;$count %= 7&#39;.</li>
<li>line 6: Use the compound form &#39;$count &lt;&lt;= 1&#39;.</li>
<li>line 7: Use the compound form &#39;$label .= &#39;-&#39; . $count . &#39;!&#39;&#39;.</li>
<li>line 8: Use the compound form &#39;$count *= 3 * $k&#39;.</li>
<li>line 9: Use the compound form &#39;$count += ($k * 2)&#39;.</li>
<li>line 10: Use the compound form &#39;$grid[1] |= 4&#39;.</li>
<li>line 11: Use the compound form &#39;$buf[0] .= &#39;z&#39;&#39;.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "OpAssignShortSyntax": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore OpAssignShortSyntax

/**
 * @noinspection OpAssignShortSyntaxInspection
 */
```
